text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Macedonian Defence Minister Blagoje Handziski obtained Turkey's support for Macedonia's association in NATO. He met in Ankara with Deputy Prime Minister Tansu Ciller and other officals.

- The Macedonian government asked for U.S. help in finding the causes of reported poisoning in the Tetovo region, the U.S. informtion centre in Skopje said. Not a single official test has yet proved there were cases of poisoning in Tetovo schools. Analyses were made by the Macedonian and Vienna forensic institutes under U.N. auspices.

- Industrial production in August this year was 1.4 percent lower compared to July last year, according to official statistics. Foreign trade stood at $220 million in July this year which is down by 3.9 percent on June the same year.

- All Macedonian children under 18 have to be vaccinated against polio. All passengers going from Macedonia to Albania and all Albanian citizens entering Macedonia should present documents showing they have been vaccinated.
